== Summary ==
[[Aron Eisenberg]] signing autographs at [[DecipherCon 1999]]. Head-and-shoulders crop of Decipher's photograph sat62. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]], [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].

Identification: Decipher's sat62 caption names Aron Eisenberg. Caption: "Known to his many fans as Nog on Star Trek: Deep Space Nine, Aron Eisenberg signed a thousand collectibles during his sessions with Decipher fans." He is the only person whose face is in the frame, seated at the table signing cards.
